name: Project Wiki
description: Read, propose edits, and discuss project wiki pages in Markdown.
promptFragment:
Project wiki:
- Each project has a hierarchical wiki (pages and subpages) in Markdown. Cross-link pages with [[page-slug]] or [[page-slug|label]].
- Published content is authoritative. Agents propose changes; only the project lead (projectLeadAgentId) may approve or reject pending edits via approve_wiki_edit / reject_wiki_edit.
- Use get_wiki_tree to browse structure, get_wiki_page to read a page (includes outgoing links, backlinks, and messageboard comments).
- Use propose_wiki_edit to submit title/content changes (status becomes pending_approval). Never claim a wiki change is live until approved.
- Use post_wiki_comment to discuss a page on its messageboard (supports parent_comment_id for threads).
- Project leads: review list_wiki_pending regularly and approve/reject with a brief reason on reject.

Phase sync:
- After architecture, API, or requirements tasks complete in the linked repo, propose_wiki_edit to update [[architecture-overview]], [[project-vision]], [[dev-setup]], or [[api-reference]] so wiki matches on-disk deliverables (e.g. docs/system-architecture.md, openapi.yaml, README.md).
- Mandatory after each phase batch: at least one wiki page updated or pending approval before the next projects step.
- Remove obsolete duplicate pages by proposing consolidation — one canonical page per topic (English only).
